title: ULPF Source Profile Contract
description: Defines the authoritative Source Context required for deterministic OCSF normalization. This context provides identity, temporal grounding, and producer metadata that cannot be reliably inferred from raw logs.

source.description: Name or identifier of the log source (e.g., syslog-001). This matches the parser source.

profile_version.description: Version string of this source profile. Independent from parser version.

capture_year.description: The authoritative year the logs were captured. Required for temporal determinism when raw logs omit the year. Runtime fallbacks to current year are explicitly forbidden.

capture_timezone.description: The authoritative timezone of the captured logs (e.g., 'UTC', 'America/New_York'). Runtime fallbacks to system local time are explicitly forbidden.

vendor_name.description: The authoritative vendor name for OCSF metadata.product.vendor_name.

product_name.description: The authoritative product name for OCSF metadata.product.name. Explicitly made required by this contract to avoid missing identities.
